chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, and Ḥusayn ibn Hāshim, and Ibn Ribāṭ, and Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, all of them from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the time of ẓuhr, so he said: “When the shadow is one cubit.”

key_terms.الْفَيْءُ: the returning shadow used to determine prayer time
key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: one cubit, a unit of measure for the shadow

ai.seo_question: When does the time of ẓuhr salat (prayer) begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the time of ẓuhr salat (prayer), identifying it in relation to the measured extent of the shadow. It reflects the jurisprudential method of determining prayer times through observable natural signs.
